chapter_title: Computer related offences
official_text: If any person dishonestly or fraudulently does any act referred to in section 43, he shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years or with fine which may extend to five lakh rupees or with both.

chapter_title: Punishment for identity theft
official_text: Whoever, fraudulently or dishonestly make use of the electronic signature, password or any other unique identification feature of any other person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.

chapter_title: Punishment for cheating by personation by using computer resource
official_text: Whoever, by means for any communication device or computer resource cheats by personating, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine which may extend to one lakh rupees.

chapter_title: Punishment for publishing or transmitting obscene material in electronic form
official_text: Whoever publishes or transmits or causes to be published or transmitted in the electronic form, any material which is lascivious or appeals to the prurient interest shall be punished.

chapter_title: Definition of Unfair Trade Practice
official_text: Unfair trade practice means a trade practice which, for the purpose of promoting the sale, use or supply of any goods or for the provision of any service, adopts any unfair method or unfair or deceptive practice including false representation, refusal of refund, or defective products.

chapter_title: Manner in which complaint shall be made
official_text: A complaint in relation to any goods sold or delivered or agreed to be sold or delivered or any service provided or agreed to be provided may be filed with a District Commission by the consumer or any recognized consumer association.

chapter_title: Findings of District Commission and Reliefs
official_text: Where the District Commission is satisfied that the goods complained against suffer from any of the defects specified in the complaint, it shall issue an order directing the seller or manufacturer to remove defect, replace product, or refund price to consumer along with compensation.

chapter_title: Transfer of property defined
official_text: In the following sections transfer of property means an act by which a living person conveys property, in present or in future, to one or more other living persons, or to himself and one or more other living persons.

chapter_title: Sale defined and how sale made
official_text: Sale is a transfer of ownership in exchange for a price paid or promised or part-paid and part-promised. Such transfer, in the case of tangible immovable property of the value of one hundred rupees and upwards, can be made only by a registered instrument. Unilateral sale without co-owner consent is invalid.

chapter_title: Lease defined
official_text: A lease of immovable property is a transfer of a right to enjoy such property, made for a certain time, express or implied, or in perpetuity, in consideration of a price paid or promised, or of money, a share of crops, service or any other thing of value.

chapter_title: Duration of certain leases in absence of written contract or local usage
official_text: In the absence of a contract or local law or usage to the contrary, a lease of immovable property for agricultural or manufacturing purposes shall be deemed to be a lease from year to year, and a lease of immovable property for any other purpose shall be deemed to be a lease from month to month, terminable by fifteen days notice.

chapter_title: Devolution of interest in coparcenary property
official_text: On and from the commencement of the Hindu Succession (Amendment) Act, 2005, in a Joint Hindu family governed by the Mitakshara law, the daughter of a coparcener shall by birth become a coparcener in her own right in the same manner as the son. Any coparcenary property shall be divided equally among all legal heirs and coparceners through a decree or registered deed of partition.

chapter_title: General rules of succession in the case of males
official_text: The property of a male Hindu dying intestate shall devolve firstly upon the heirs being the Class I relatives specified in the Schedule, including sons, daughters, widow, and mother, all taking equal shares simultaneously.

chapter_title: Property of a female Hindu to be her absolute property
official_text: Any property possessed by a female Hindu, whether acquired before or after the commencement of this Act, shall be held by her as full owner thereof and not as a limited owner.

chapter_title: General rules of succession in the case of female Hindus
official_text: The property of a female Hindu dying intestate shall devolve firstly upon the children (including the children of any deceased child) and the husband.

chapter_title: Sexual intercourse by employing deceitful means
official_text: Whoever, by deceitful means or making by a promise to marry without any intention of fulfilling the same, has sexual intercourse with a woman not amounting to rape, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years.

chapter_title: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
official_text: Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.

chapter_title: Act endangering life or personal safety of others
official_text: Whoever does any act so rashly or negligently as to endanger human life or the personal safety of others, causing hurt or grievous hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment or fine.

chapter_title: Rash driving or riding on a public way
official_text: Whoever drives any vehicle, or rides, on any public way in a manner so rash or negligent as to endanger human life, or to be likely to cause hurt or injury to any other person, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine.

chapter_title: Extortion by putting person in fear of death or grievous hurt
official_text: Whoever commits extortion by putting any person in fear of death or of grievous hurt to that person or to any other, shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years.

chapter_title: Criminal breach of trust
official_text: Whoever, being in any manner entrusted with property, or with any dominion over property, dishonestly misappropriates or converts to his own use that property, commits criminal breach of trust.

chapter_title: Cheating
official_text: Whoever, by deceiving any person, fraudulently or dishonestly induces the person so deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to consent that any person shall retain any property, commits cheating.

chapter_title: Tenancy Agreement Mandate
official_text: No person shall let or take on rent any premises except by an agreement in writing, which shall be informed to the Rent Authority within two months from the date of agreement.

chapter_title: Security Deposit Cap and Refund
official_text: The security deposit to be paid by the tenant in advance shall not exceed two months' rent in case of residential premises, and six months' rent in case of non-residential premises. The security deposit shall be refunded to the tenant on the date of taking over vacant possession of the premises, after making deductions, if any, of any arrears of rent and damages to premises.

chapter_title: Protection against Arbitrary Eviction
official_text: No landlord shall evict or dispossess any tenant from any premises except by an order of the Rent Tribunal made on an application filed before it. Landlord cannot cut off or withhold any essential supply or service in the premises occupied by the tenant.

chapter_title: Repossession of Premises by Landlord
official_text: The Rent Court may, on an application made to it by the landlord, make an order for the recovery of possession of the premises on grounds of non-payment of rent, misuse, or breach of tenancy agreement.

chapter_title: Responsibility for payment of wages
official_text: Every employer shall be responsible for the payment to persons employed by him of all wages required to be paid under this Act.

chapter_title: Time of payment of wages
official_text: The wages of every person employed upon or in any railway, factory or industrial or other establishment shall be paid before the expiry of the seventh day or tenth day after the last day of the wage-period in respect of which the wages are payable.

chapter_title: Deductions which may be made from wages
official_text: The wages of an employed person shall be paid to him without deductions of any kind except those authorized by or under this Act, such as deductions for absence from duty, damage to or loss of goods, or recovery of advances.

chapter_title: Claims arising out of deductions from wages or delay in payment
official_text: Where contrary to the provisions of this Act any deduction has been made from the wages of an employed person, or any payment of wages has been delayed, such person may apply to the Authority appointed under this section for direction of refund or compensation.
